notes: «سمعت البراء» makes the Companion the last link of the chain; «قال أبو بكر مررنا براع» is Abu Bakr's own speech inside Bara's account: whether he is a further last link (rule 6) cannot be settled from the text, so he is not added and the report needs a ruling; «رضى الله عنه» is a blessing; the Prophet is not a link
